designationHistory.name: Lacreek Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Lacreek Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, about 9,362 acres in Bennett County, South Dakota, by Executive Order 7160.
designationHistory.note: Renamed Lacreek National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
